note: Two paragraphs used `data-ana2` instead of the comma-separated `data-ana` convention. Merged to `data-ana="ana_25,ana_03"` (line 418) and `data-ana="ana_23,ana_24"` (line 498) so the inspector can resolve both findings.

The teaser was `display:none`, which removes it from the accessibility tree AND prevents it from acting as a visual fallback if the video fails to load. Replaced with `z-index:0` so the img sits behind the video and is shown only if the video cannot render — preserving the alt text for screen readers and providing a graceful degradation.
